features.title: Features that fit regulated operations
features.intro: Every module shares one database, one audit trail and one permission model.

pos.title: Point of sale
pos.body: Quick checkout with barcode and QR scanning, member validation before every transaction, multiple terminals and printed or digital receipts.

assoc.title: Allocation records
assoc.body: Record every allocation to a member, check membership status and allocation limits before each transaction, and keep a tamper-evident log.

membership.title: Membership management
membership.body: Member profiles with identity verification, digital membership cards with QR codes, expiry tracking and instant deactivation.

inventory.title: Inventory and stock control
inventory.body: Real-time stock by location with batch tracking, supplier records, returns and blind stock counts compared with system quantities.

compliance.title: Audit trails and reporting
compliance.body: Every stock movement, sale and membership change is logged with who, what and when. Export the data you need for your own reporting.

finance.title: Financial records
finance.body: Sales and expense tracking, daily cash-up, cost of sales and gross profit per location.
bullets: Cost of sales and margin reports

assoc.title: Fees and member accounts
assoc.body: Track membership fees, member account balances and association expenses with clear reports for your treasurer and members' meetings.

analytics.title: Operational insights
analytics.body: Understand visits, busy periods and stock turnover with dashboards built from your own data.

multistore.title: Multi-site management
multistore.body: Run several locations with central catalogues, per-site stock, staff assignments and consolidated reporting.

security.title: Roles and permissions
security.body: Give owners, managers and cashiers exactly the access they need. Sensitive screens can be limited by role.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.intro: Pay per account, per month. No hardware lock-in and no per-transaction fees from Budify.
pricing.currencyNote: Prices shown in {currency}, excluding taxes. Indicative list prices – final prices are confirmed in your quote.
faq: Prices exclude VAT, GST or other applicable taxes.
Hardware (terminals, scanners, printers) is purchased separately from the supplier of your choice.
Plans may differ by market depending on available modules.

integrations.title: Integrations and reporting
integrations.intro: Budify connects to the hardware and finance tools operators use, and produces exports for regulatory reporting. Availability differs by market.

hardware.title: Hardware
hardware.body: Works with Android POS terminals, barcode scanners and receipt printers. Compatible devices are listed during onboarding.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Record cash, card and account payments. Payment-provider integrations depend on your market and are confirmed during onboarding.

accounting.title: Accounting exports
accounting.body: Export sales, expenses and stock valuation as CSV for your accountant or accounting software.

api.title: Data exports and API
api.body: Scheduled CSV exports today; a documented API and webhooks are on our roadmap.

integrations.traceIntro: The list below shows the state of each option for your market. “Roadmap” means planned but not yet available. Budify does not file reports on your behalf and is not a licensed seed-to-sale system.

security.title: Security
security.intro: We design Budify so that each operator's data is separated from every other operator's data.

items.title: Tenant isolation
items.body: Each organisation's data is separated at database level with row-level access rules.

items.title: Role-based access
items.body: Owners, managers and cashiers only see what their role allows.

items.title: Audit trails
items.body: Key actions are logged with user, time and change.

about.title: Next-generation operations for regulated operators
about.body: Budify is a software platform that helps licensed operators streamline operations, keep accurate records and deliver a better member experience – from point of sale to member validation, all in one system.
about.c1b: Designed around record-keeping and reporting needs, so you can meet the rules that apply to you.
about.c2b: POS, membership, inventory, finance and communications in a single platform – no patchwork tools.
about.c3b: Live dashboards and analytics for clear, fast decisions every day.
about.c4b: Digital membership cards, QR validation and tools your members will actually use.
